threshold.value: With respect to Party A, infinite; with respect to Party B, USD 50,000, provided that if an Event of Default or Additional Termination Event has occurred and is continuing with respect to Party B, then zero.
threshold.evidence_quote: “Threshold” means, with respect to Party A, infinite; with respect to Party B shall be USD 50,000; provided that, if an Event of Default or Additional Termination Event has occurred and is continuing with respect to Party B, then the Threshold with respect to Party B shall be zero.

minimum_transfer_amount.value: USD 250,000 with respect to a party; provided that it shall not apply to the Independent Amount, and if an Event of Default or Additional Termination Event has occurred and is continuing with respect to Party B, then zero for Party B.
minimum_transfer_amount.evidence_quote: “Minimum Transfer Amount” means, with respect to a party, USD 250,000; provided that, notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, the Minimum Transfer Amount shall not apply to the Independent Amount, and provided further that, if an Event of Default or Additional Termination Event has occurred and is continuing with respect to Party B, then the Minimum Transfer Amount with respect to Party B shall be zero.

rounding.value: The Delivery Amount and the Return Amount shall be rounded up and down respectively to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000.
rounding.evidence_quote: The Delivery Amount and the Return Amount shall be rounded up and down respectively to the nearest integral multiple of USD 10,000.

valuation_percentage.value: US-CASH: 100%; US-TBILL, US-TNOTE, US-TBOND, US-STRIP, US-TIPS, US-GNMA, US-FNMA, US-FHLMC, US-FHLB, US-FHLBNC, US-FHLBNCDN, US-NCAD, US-NCADN, US-GNMAMBS, US-FNMAMBS, US-FHLMCMBS, US-ARM: ranging from 95% to 99.5% based on maturity; Agency CMO’s and REMICS: 90%.
valuation_percentage.evidence_quote: Percentage shown is the Valuation Percentage applicable to the indicated combination of ICAD and Remaining Maturity.
